subject.title: Feature request: Add CarPlay support to the official iOS app

question: Should OpenClaw pursue official iOS CarPlay support now, and if so which Apple CarPlay category, entitlement path, and constrained Talk UX should the official app target?
rationale: The request is a new official app and release-signing surface, not a broken existing contract; automation cannot choose the Apple category, App Store entitlement strategy, or driving-safety product model.

options.title: Keep and scope CarPlay
options.body: Keep this issue open as the canonical CarPlay request and ask iOS owners to define the category, entitlement plan, and minimal Talk-only UX before implementation.

options.title: Fold into mobile RFC
options.body: Move the idea into the mobile app RFC process if maintainers want CarPlay evaluated with broader iOS and Android design direction before accepting platform-specific work.

options.title: Decline for now
options.body: Close only if maintainers decide CarPlay entitlement, review, or safety constraints make this out of scope for the official app in the near term.

recommendation.title: Keep and scope CarPlay
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as the canonical CarPlay request and ask iOS owners to define the category, entitlement plan, and minimal Talk-only UX before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: The iOS app and Talk history most strongly route this product/signing decision to the recent iOS app owner path.
